notes: StaticTree JSON only has params.nodes. Tree shape is the shared complete-binary-heap rule: parent(i)=i/2, root=1, element-div, no text.
Same rule as nana-runtime-benchmark::tree_mutations. A flat column of N text leaves is not this tree.
cpu_frame_ms is view construction + UserInterface::build (layout) + draw. present_ms is GPU submit wait and is not folded into cpu_frame_ms.

frames_after_idle counts UserInterface redraw requests (NextFrame/At) after settle. The settle present is not counted. idle_schedule_ms is not this field. A busy pulse that calls shell.request_redraw on RedrawRequested is required to produce a non-zero count before 0 is emitted.
